title: add-rag-autorun-stub-templates-and-playground-orchestration
author: Evan Zhang
release_notes: Added lightweight RAG autorun templates and a local playground orchestration sample. Useful for onboarding engineers to run end-to-end RAG scenarios with minimal setup.
description:
Summary: This PR introduces a lightweight 'autorun' set of RAG templates and a small local orchestration playground aimed at speeding developer onboarding and automated smoke-runs. The goal is to provide opinionated, tiny templates that wire together retrieval, a tool-calling agent, and telemetry probes so engineers can run a deterministic demo locally (devcontainer or node) and iterate on prompts, indexers, and tool stubs.

Motivation and context: We repeatedly see new users spending time wiring a minimal loop (index -> retrieval -> agent -> tool). Long-form quickstarts are great, but a small autorun scaffold reduces friction for running reproducible scenarios (useful for demos, evals, and CI smoke). This PR complements existing quickstarts by adding: 1) autorun TS templates for a single-step RAG session; 2) a tiny orchestrator to run sequences of tool-calls deterministically; 3) docsite guide and a short video link; 4) telemetry probe hooks for structured-output checks.

What I changed (high level commits):
- commit 1: feat: add autorun scaffold and example dataset (templates/autorun-ts, examples/demo-index.json)
- commit 2: feat: add lightweight orchestrator (packages/autorun-orch/index.ts) + README with run modes (local/devcontainer/ci)
- commit 3: docs: add docsite page and short runbook (docs/rag/autorun-playground.md)
- commit 4: test: add smoke CI job to exercise autorun (ci/autorun-smoke.yml)
- commit 5: chore: add telemetry probes and example config (telemetry/probes/autorun.json)

Files touched (representative):
- packages/autorun-orch/index.ts       (new) - small orchestrator with support for tool stubbing, deterministic seeding
- templates/autorun-ts/template.json   (new) - quickstart template that wires Redwood SDK calls, retrieval config, and an autorun entrypoint
- examples/demo-index.json             (new) - tiny in-memory index with 6 documents for deterministic retrieval
- docs/rag/autorun-playground.md      (new) - docsite page with steps for devcontainer and CI usage
- ci/autorun-smoke.yml                (new) - GitHub Actions job to run the autorun scenario for smoke checks
- telemetry/probes/autorun.json       (new) - structured-output probes and example assertions
- package.json (root)                 (modified) - add new workspace and scripts
- devcontainer/devcontainer.json      (modified) - add postCreateCommand to run autorun bootstrap

Small code excerpt (autorun orchestrator):

const seed = process.env.AUTORUN_SEED || 'local-01';
const steps = [{type: 'retrieve', query: 'How to configure batching?'}, {type: 'agent', instruction: 'Answer using source summaries and call search_tool if needed.'}];
for (const step of steps) {
  // deterministic runtime, pluggable tool stubs
  await runStep(step, {seed, toolStubs});
}

Checklist: 
- [x] Templates added and documented
- [x] Devcontainer & scripts for local run verified
- [x] CI smoke job executes the basic autorun flow
- [x] Telemetry probes added for structured output checks
- [x] Reviewed and approved by reviewers

Review conversation (high level):
- Maya Thompson (reviewer): "Nice UX improvement — can we keep template options minimal and ensure we don't accidentally ship credentials in examples? Also requested a small README note about KMS/hsm placeholders."
- Author (Evan): "Addressed: removed any real creds, replaced with explicit placeholders and added README section about secrets and KMS integrations."
- Luis Ortega (reviewer): "CI job failed on first run due to network timeouts hitting external indexer — can we pin to the in-memory index during smoke?"
- Author: "Updated CI to use examples/demo-index.json and disabled external fetch in smoke mode; reran CI."
- Nina Park (approver): "Approved after verifying the smoke job; doc looks clear and devcontainer boot is reliable. Left one nit on wording which I fixed."

CI: Initial run failed (network to external indexer). After switching to in-memory index CI job passed on rerun. Full matrix: node 18/20, lint/format passed, smoke job passed.

Why this change is safe: The autorun templates are opt-in in templates/autorun-ts and referenced from docs only. No production runtime code was modified. New orchestrator is a small dev-only package (marked devDependency) and the CI smoke job is allowed to run only on PRs that change examples/docs (guarded by paths).

Migration / docs: docs/rag/autorun-playground.md contains step-by-step usage, troubleshooting, and a short embed of a 90s run-through video (hosted on internal CDN). Suggested next steps in docs: integrate autorun into our eval harness as a reproducible smoke scenario.

Notes for reviewers/maintainers:
- If we expand the autorun scenarios, consider extracting common index fixtures under examples/fixtures to reuse across quickstarts and CI.
- Consider a follow-up to add a lightweight Rust/WASM shim for edge-friendly autorun in constrained environments.

Merge: squashed and merged to main. Merge commit: "feat(autorun): add rag autorun templates and playground orchestration (squash)".

Related: ENG-4821 (internal), PM-109 (product request to shorten onboarding demo).

If you want to run locally: clone, cd packages/autorun-orch, npm install, npm run bootstrap && npm run autorun:local (or open devcontainer). The docs page includes exact commands.
